notes: Why the maturity score ties, answering the open half of issue #42. Per patient per axis: tie structure of the full marker set, the fraction of cells expressing no marker at all, and a sweep over every marker subset of size k to test whether marker COUNT is the lever. Measures which fix is possible; deliberately proposes none, since choosing an axis after seeing which one separates is what the freeze exists to prevent.
